title: Semantic preservation versus surface distance
research_question: Were meanings preserved across the observed surface changes?
filters: all approved available non-C0 rewrites; manipulation check independent of primary complete-case eligibility
main_observation: Semantic similarity scores are unavailable. This plot uses reviewed preservation decisions as a binary outcome, without inventing semantic scores.
allowed_interpretation: Reviewed binary decisions and recorded similarity scores are distinct evidence types.
forbidden_interpretation: Neither lexical cosine nor missing semantic scores are evidence of semantic equivalence.
